scripts.topic: Turn Messy Lecture Notes into an Anki Cloze Deck in 60 Seconds
scripts.text: Instead of asking AI for conversational flashcards you have to manually retype, force it to output exact Cloze. Eliminates the tedious 45-minute friction of making active-recall cards without sacrificing card quality. The trick is simple: Prompt the model to use the exact syntax '{{c1::hidden answer}}' formatted as semicolon-separated lines, then save as a .txt file and use File > Import in Anki. Most students skip this because it feels too small to matter, but the small step is what makes the rest stick. Try it once, give it 20 minutes, then compare what you remember with what you would have remembered without it. If the result surprises you, keep the habit for one week and note what changed.

scripts.topic: Why Ballpoint Pens Cause Hand Cramps Below a 60-Degree Angle
scripts.text: Writing fatigue in long exams is caused by the pen's brass collar scraping paper, not muscle weakness. Students can eliminate hand strain in 3-hour written exams simply by adjusting their pen tilt to engage rolling friction. The trick is simple: Keep the pen above 60 degrees relative to the paper so the tungsten carbide ball rolls instead of dragging the outer brass socket.
